name: Prism
description: A Spotlight-like search window (the window only). It takes the keyboard when the user's command opens it, because it is a search box, and gives it back on close. Other modules supply the rows.

extensionPoints.description: Sources that supply rows to the Prism window

anchor.description: Where the window sits in the usable area of the screen

offsetX.description: Horizontal offset from the anchor; positive moves right

offsetY.description: Vertical offset from the anchor; positive moves down. Unset is one fifth of the usable height for the top anchor and 0 for the others

margin.description: Gap kept to the edges of the usable area; unset is the large spacing token

widthShare.description: Share of the usable width; when set it replaces width

maxHeight.description: Largest height of the window; the results scroll beyond it

maxHeightShare.description: Share of the usable height; when set it replaces maxHeight

screen.description: Output name the window opens on; empty follows the focus

closeOnOutside.description: A click outside the window closes it

keepText.description: The input keeps its last text the next time the window opens

wrapSelection.description: Up at the first row goes to the last and down at the last goes to the first

maxRows.description: Rows shown before the list scrolls

rowHeight.description: Height of a row; unset is the body and caption text sizes plus twice the medium spacing

iconSize.description: Size of a row's icon; unset is the row height minus twice the small spacing

inputPosition.description: Where the input sits in the window; the results grow away from it

preview.description: Fill the results with fixed sample rows to judge the look

placeholder.description: Text shown in an empty input

emptyNoSource.description: Empty state when nothing supplies rows and the input is empty

emptyNoMatch.description: Empty state when the input has text and no row remains

showSubtitle.description: Show the subtitle of a row

showIcon.description: Show the icon of a row

showHint.description: Show the right-side hint of a row

prefixApps.description: The letter after @ that selects the apps mode

prefixFiles.description: The letter after @ that selects the files mode

prefixWeb.description: The letter after @ that selects the web search mode

prefixCommands.description: The letter after @ that selects the commands mode

prefixGrep.description: The letter after @ that selects the grep mode

radius.description: Corner radius of the window; unset is the large radius token

inputRadius.description: Corner radius of the input; unset is the medium radius token

rowRadius.description: Corner radius of a row; unset is the medium radius token

borderWidth.description: Width of the window border; unset is the thin border token

padding.description: Padding inside the window; unset is the large spacing token

inputPadding.description: Padding inside the input; unset is the medium spacing token

rowPadding.description: Padding inside a row; unset is the medium spacing token

gap.description: Space between the input and the results; unset is the small spacing token

rowGap.description: Space between rows; unset is the extra small spacing token

separator.description: Draw a line between the input and the results

separatorWidth.description: Width of the separator line; unset is the thin border token

shadow.description: Draw a shadow under the window

shadowBlur.description: Blur of the shadow; unset is the extra large spacing token

shadowOffset.description: Downward offset of the shadow; unset is the small spacing token

backdrop.description: Dim the rest of the screen while the window is open

prefixOpacity.description: Opacity of the highlight behind a recognized prefix

animation.description: How the window appears and disappears

animationDuration.description: Duration in milliseconds; unset is the normal motion token, 0 shows and hides at once

animationScale.description: Starting scale of the scale animation; 1 means no scaling

windowRole.description: Theme role of the window background

borderRole.description: Theme role of the window border

inputRole.description: Theme role of the input background

inputTextRole.description: Theme role of the input text

placeholderRole.description: Theme role of the placeholder text

prefixRole.description: Theme role of the highlight behind a recognized prefix

titleRole.description: Theme role of a row title

subtitleRole.description: Theme role of a row subtitle

hintRole.description: Theme role of a row hint

selectedRole.description: Theme role of the selected row background

selectedTextRole.description: Theme role of the text of the selected row

hoverRole.description: Theme role of the hovered row background

separatorRole.description: Theme role of the separator line

footerRole.description: Theme role of the footer text

emptyRole.description: Theme role of the empty-state text

matchRole.description: Theme role of marked (matching) text in a row title

messageRole.description: Theme role of the message line (a hint from a source)

errorRole.description: Theme role of the message line when it shows an error

selectedOpacity.description: Opacity of the selected row background

hoverOpacity.description: Opacity of the hovered row background

fontFamily.description: Font family of the window; unset is the design token family

fontSize.description: Base text size of the window; unset is the body text token

fontWeight.description: Text weight of the window; unset is regular

inputFontFamily.description: Font family of the input; unset follows the window

inputFontSize.description: Text size of the input; unset is the title text token

inputFontWeight.description: Text weight of the input; unset follows the window

inputFontItalic.description: Italic text in the input; unset follows the window

placeholderFontFamily.description: Font family of the placeholder; unset follows the window

placeholderFontSize.description: Text size of the placeholder; unset follows the input

placeholderFontWeight.description: Text weight of the placeholder; unset follows the window

placeholderFontItalic.description: Italic placeholder; unset follows the window

titleFontFamily.description: Font family of a row title; unset follows the window

titleFontSize.description: Text size of a row title; unset is the body text token

titleFontWeight.description: Text weight of a row title; unset follows the window

titleFontItalic.description: Italic row title; unset follows the window

subtitleFontFamily.description: Font family of a row subtitle; unset follows the window

subtitleFontSize.description: Text size of a row subtitle; unset is the caption text token

subtitleFontWeight.description: Text weight of a row subtitle; unset follows the window

subtitleFontItalic.description: Italic row subtitle; unset follows the window

hintFontFamily.description: Font family of a row hint; unset follows the window

hintFontSize.description: Text size of a row hint; unset is the caption text token

hintFontWeight.description: Text weight of a row hint; unset follows the window

hintFontItalic.description: Italic row hint; unset follows the window

footerFontFamily.description: Font family of the footer; unset follows the window

footerFontSize.description: Text size of the footer; unset is the caption text token

footerFontWeight.description: Text weight of the footer; unset follows the window

footerFontItalic.description: Italic footer; unset follows the window

emptyFontFamily.description: Font family of the empty-state text; unset follows the window

emptyFontSize.description: Text size of the empty-state text; unset is the body text token

emptyFontWeight.description: Text weight of the empty-state text; unset follows the window

emptyFontItalic.description: Italic empty-state text; unset follows the window
